summary: Iteration 45 - STEEVE-MAX V3 (Zone d'Analyse + Performance) Testing Complete. All features verified: (1) Map loads with V10 corridors and 26 zones displayed correctly with score 55/100. (2) ZONES tab opens with hierarchy labels (DOMINANT, SECONDAIRE, TERTIAIRE) and all three toggles work. (3) Toggle Zones OFF/ON hides/shows zone polygons. (4) Toggle Corridors OFF/ON hides/shows corridors. (5) Toggle Points OFF/ON hides/shows points. (6) POINTS CHAUDS tab mode toggle activates/deactivates with all 7 behavior filters present. (7) Corridors V10 master toggle works correctly. (8) Wind flow layer toggle works with both Minimaliste and Particules modes. (9) Analysis zone mode (2km×2km) automatically activates with waypoint selection - zones inside box at full opacity, zones outside dimmed. (10) Score displayed correctly (55/100). (11) SEUIL 30% slider visible in toolbar. (12) No critical JavaScript errors.
